[[File:Brilanimagery avatar.jpg|thumb|right|260px|brilanimagery.]]
'''brilanimagery''' is a photographer whose image is used on one [[Players Committee]] [[Virtual cards|Virtual card]].<ref name="cardlabels">[https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/src/gemp-swccg-cards/src/main/resources/card_labels.json card_labels.json] in billbisco/swccg-gemp (commit 0bc4377d9): the printed labels of every Players Committee Virtual card, transcribed from the PC's card images (res.starwarsccg.org). Field definitions: [https://github.com/billbisco/swccg-gemp/blob/0bc4377d9dd48a100625e0ec75de6032d2ea92a1/docs/card_labels.md docs/card_labels.md].</ref> The card prints the credit as "Image courtesy of sandierrzza & brilanimagery @ Instagram". The credit points to Instagram, a photo-sharing site. The same credit line also names sandierrzza. The credited card is [[Cara Dune With Heavy Blaster Rifle|•Cara Dune With Heavy Blaster Rifle]], in [[Virtual Set 19]] (released 2022).
